create_FittedTrajectory: create a FittedTrajectory protobuf message to store motion capture trajectory data with walkers and timesteps
create_WalkerPose: create a WalkerPose protobuf message to represent a walker position, joints, and velocity at a timestep
create_Walker: create a Walker protobuf message to define a walker model with scaling, markers, and mass
create_TimestepData: create a TimestepData protobuf message to hold walker and prop pose data for a single timestep
create_Marker: create a Marker protobuf message to define a motion capture marker with name, parent, position, and quaternion
